summary: Re-tested iter22 AggLayout gap fix. All 3 floating components (FloatingSuggestButton, FloatingWriteButton, BackToFeedButton) are now hoisted into App.js after <Routes> inside <ChromeLayout> and render on BOTH /news (AggLayout) and / (Layout) routes. Verified single-mount (no duplicates), correct gating (write/back only when authed approved; back hidden on /feed). Aggregator hero now shows '40+ SOURCES'. Anonymous Suggest modal submission to POST /api/improvements returned 200 and modal closed cleanly. Frontend-only test as requested.

verification_matrix.no_duplicates_check: every page returned exactly ONE [data-testid='floating-suggest-btn'] — no double mount

critical_code_review_comments: Note: FloatingSuggestButton uses sonner toast (duration 2200ms). Test captured the closed modal + 200 response as success signal; toast string was not asserted because it disappeared before assertion. No functional issue, but if future tests want to assert the toast, capture it within ~1.5s of submit or extend Toaster duration in test mode.

Mild design observation: FloatingSuggestButton appears slightly tight against the AggLayout footer on short pages. AggLayout now has pb-24 sm:pb-8 which is fine on mobile but on small desktop the footer is closer to the pill than on Layout (cream). Not a blocker.
test_credentials: Admin session cookie session_token=tok_smoke_admin_v2 (worked as Cookie, no Bearer needed for SSR-rendered floats).
seed_data_creation: One improvement record POSTed anonymously from /news/about as part of integration check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter22 gap is fully closed. All three floating components live in App.js AFTER <Routes> inside <ChromeLayout>. Gating logic (authed/onFeed/onWrite) is inside each component, so a single mount is safe across both layouts. AggHero stat correctly reads '40+ SOURCES'. Backend untouched; previous iter22 backend report is still valid.
rca of the issue: iter22 root cause was that Layout.jsx alone rendered the floats — /news/* uses AggLayout, so the buttons disappeared. Fix: hoist <BackToFeedButton/>, <FloatingWriteButton/>, <FloatingSuggestButton/> from Layout.jsx into App.js right after <Routes/> inside the dynamically-chosen <ChromeLayout>. Verified — singleton mounts, correct route gating, correct auth gating.
